description: Adjacent ML researcher — knows general ML/deep learning, Transformers, standard evaluation practice, and statistics, but not computer vision segmentation subfield terminology, datasets, or prior work.
assumed_knowledge: Foundation models and the NLP prompting paradigm (GPT, CLIP at high level)
Standard evaluation metrics (IoU, precision, recall, AP)
Focal loss, dice loss at high level
terms_to_define: instance segmentation vs. semantic segmentation vs. panoptic segmentation
SA-1B (the dataset produced by this work)
binding_personas: NLP researcher who understands GPT-style prompting but not segmentation datasets
Reinforcement learning researcher interested in composable perception modules
Generative model researcher (diffusion/GAN) who uses segmentation as a preprocessing step
